{{Dialogue|Seek|Anakin… really was ''special'', wasn't he?|Amee|Yeah. Like no one else.|Melee|Sometimes I wonder… how it would have gone if he'd been here to ''protect'' us all along.|attr=Seek, Amee, and Melee discuss Anakin Skywalker|src=<ref name="Vader50" />}}
'''Seek''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] from the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. In [[32 BBY]], he and a group of friends visited the [[Slavery|enslaved]] boy [[Anakin Skywalker]] in [[Mos Espa]] [[spaceport]] while Skywalker was working on a [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer|podracer]]. Unimpressed by the other boy's [[Technician|mechanical]] skills, Seek cruelly suggested that he would be squashed while [[Podracing|racing]] and left to play ball.

By between [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]], Seek was enslaved on a Tatooine [[Unidentified moisture farm|moisture farm]] with his [[Youngling|childhood]] friends [[Amee]] and [[Melee]]. The trio were freed when [[Kitster Banai]] and [[Wald]], another pair of childhood friends, returned to Tatooine and paid the [[Unidentified moisture farmer enslaver|owner]] of the [[farm]] enough to free all the workers there.

Banai and Wald then sought out Seek, Melee, and Amee and the group left the farm and sat around a [[fire]] into the [[Local day|night]] discussing Skywalker and their lives. A group of [[Thief|thieves]] then confronted the group and demanded that Banai and Wald hand over several [[Energy capsule (technology)|energy capsules]] that they had stolen from the [[Galactic Empire]]. After receiving the capsules, the thieves were [[Death|killed]] by the [[Sith assassin]] [[Ochi|Ochi of Bestoon]], who left with the capsules. 

==Biography==
===Cruel kid===
{{Quote|Come on. Let's go and play ball. Keep racing, Ani. You're gonna be bug squash.|Seek|audio=Seek-BugSquash.flac|<ref name="TPM" />}}
[[File:AnakinShowsOffPod-TPM.png|thumb|left|300px|Seek was unimpressed with Anakin Skywalker's technical abilities and indifferent to his pod.]]
Seek was a [[human]]<ref name="TPM" /> [[Gender|boy]]<ref name="Geektionary" /> [[Homeworld|from]] the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]<ref name="Geektionary French" /> who was [[Reproduction|born]] around [[42 BBY]]. When Seek was ten, in [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Birth" /> he and a group of other children visited his friend [[Anakin Skywalker]]<ref name="Geektionary" /> in a courtyard of [[Slave Quarters Row]] in [[Mos Espa]] [[spaceport]].<ref name="CompleteLocations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> Skywalker was working on his [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer|podracer]] and revealed that he was going to participate in the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|podrace]] taking place the next [[Standard day|day]], causing the children [[Kitster Banai]], [[Wald]], [[Amee]], and [[Melee]] to express doubts about his chances.<ref name="TPM" />

Seek was so indifferent that he suggested that the group go and play a ball game. He then cruelly predicted that Skywalker would crash during the race<ref name="Geektionary" /> before he and all of the group bar Banai left while giggling. Skywalker instead won the race and subsequently left Tatooine.<ref name="TPM" /> Banai and Wald also eventually left Tatooine after being rescued from slavery by [[Sabé]] and [[Tonra]], a pair of [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]] agents who also saw them offworld.<ref name="Vader23">[[Darth Vader (2020) 23|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 23]]</ref> Seek remained on Tatooine with Melee and Amee, but before he left, Banai promised them that he would return if he could.<ref name="Vader50" /> By between [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]],<ref name="VaderDate">{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-marvel|text=SWCE 2023: Marvel Reveals ''Star Wars: Dark Droids'' Horror Event and More}} states that the events of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series [[Star Wars: Darth Vader (2020)|''Star Wars: Darth Vader'']], including [[Darth Vader (2020) 50|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 50]], take place between the events of {{Film|V}} and {{Film|VI}}, which are dated to [[3 ABY]] and [[4 ABY]], respectively, by ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''.</ref> Seek and his two remaining companions were enslaved by the [[Unidentified moisture farmer enslaver|owner]] of a [[Unidentified moisture farm|moisture farm]] on Tatooine where they worked.<ref name="Vader50" />

===Freedom and reunion===
{{Dialogue|Banai|Amee! Melee! Seek!|Melee|Wha…?|Seek|Kitster!|Amee|Wald!|attr=Kitster Banai greets Seek, Amee, and Melee|src=<ref name="Vader50" />}}
[[File:SeekAmeeMelee-2020DarthVader50.png|thumb|right|300px|Seek, Amee, and Melee were freed from enslavement by Kitster Banai and Wald.]]
In that period,<ref name="VaderDate" /> Banai and Wald returned to Tatooine and sold an [[Energy capsule (technology)|energy capsule]] that they had [[Thief|stolen]] from the [[Galactic Empire]] to a [[Unidentified vendor (energy capsule)|vendor]]. The pair then approached the owner of the [[farm]] where Seek and the others worked and tried to free the trio, but after the owner declared that all three would be needed for the farm to get through the season, Banai and Wald used the [[Currency|money]] from selling the capsule to free every worker on the farm. They then sought out their free friends, who were happy to be reunited with them. The group then left the farm and sat around a [[fire]] into the [[Local day|night]] discussing their lives and Skywalker, who Seek admitted had been special.<ref name="Vader50" />

As Banai began suggesting the group try and find Skywalker, a group of thieves confronted the group of friends and [[Unidentified thief (Tatooine)|one]] shot Banai in the shoulder with a [[blaster]]. Seek rose to a crouched position with one fist raised as the thieves demanded that Banai and Wald hand over the rest of their energy capsules, revealing that they had [[Death|killed]] the [[Merchant|vendor]] that had bought the other capsule from them. Banai claimed there were no more, but when the thief threatened Melee, Banai and Wald revealed the remaining capsules and handed them over.<ref name="Vader50" />

[[File:EnergyCapsuleThieves-2020DarthVader50.png|thumb|left|300px|Seek and his friends were confronted by thieves on Tatooine.]]
The thieves were then all killed by the [[Sith assassin]] [[Ochi|Ochi of Bestoon]], who had previously encountered Banai and Wald. The [[assassin]] took the capsules and acknowledged the pair before leaving without harming Seek or the others. Ochi returned the capsules to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] Darth Vader, who was in fact Skywalker, and mentioned that he had encountered Seek's group but left them alive. When the assassin asked if he should return to kill the group, Vader ordered him to leave them be.<ref name="Vader50" />

==Personality and traits==
During his childhood, Seek was unimpressed by Skywalker's [[Technician|mechanical]] talents and was cruel to the other child<ref name="Geektionary" /> but as an adult he came to believe that Skywalker was special.<ref name="Vader50" /> He was [[Color|red]]-headed with light, freckled skin and dark [[eye]]s.<ref name="TPM" />

==Equipment==
As a child, Seek wore brown and gray [[robe]]s with a black [[scarf]] and brown [[belt]].<ref name="TPM" /> As an adult, he wore a similar outfit, with a gray [[Clothing|shirt]], brown pants, brown boots, and a black scarf.<ref name="Vader50" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It was just the most exciting thing to see your child get a part in a film like this. We were treated like royalty in Tunisia. It was just a fantastic experience.|Alison Walpole|<ref name="ForceNet">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/episode1/story/article_on_oliver_walpole_79549.asp|text=Article on Oliver Walpole|author=Scott|date=1999-07-13|work=[[TheForce.net]]|archiveurl=https://archive.is/qlFdP|archivedate=2021-05-24}}</ref>}}
Seek was portrayed by [[Oliver Walpole]] in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. His name was not stated in the film but was given in the credits.<ref name="TPM" /> Walpole is the son of the film's set decorator, [[Peter Walpole]], and visited [[Leavesden Studios]] with his father to see the sets. As Oliver was the same size as [[Jake Lloyd]], who played Anakin Skywalker, he tried out one of the [[podracer]]s seen in the film. Director [[George Lucas]] spotted Oliver in the vehicle and suggested that he take a screen test. Two weeks later, Oliver learned that he had a speaking part in the film and was flown out with his mother, Alison, to [[Tunisia]] to shoot for ten days.<ref name="ForceNet" />
